newsitem.title: USA: Property owner makes way for Seattle stadium - paper.
newsitem.headline: Property owner makes way for Seattle stadium - paper.

text.p: A major property owner has agreed to vacate its site near the Kingdome to clear the way for a $414 million baseball stadium project, according to a published report on Wednesday.

The Seattle Times newspaper reported that C.C. Filson Co, which manufactures outdoor clothing and luggage, was the last of seven property owners to reach agreement with the Public Facilities District, which oversees the stadium project for the Seattle Mariners.
The terms of the Filson deal were not disclosed, but as part of the agreement, Filson will end its lawsuits against the stadium and agree to vacate the site by April 15, the newspaper reported.
The Public Facilities District and the stadium, however, still face another four lawsuits, the Seattle Times reported.
